summary.headline: Advantia Health secures $716K in annual savings across 7 categories; $77K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners partnered with Advantia Health to optimize clinical and back-office spend. The engagement has validated $716,000 in annual cost reductions spanning Revenue Cycle Management, Medical & Lab Supplies, Sonography staffing, IUD procurement and IT Managed Services. Two initiatives (IUD Order Management and the Bayer Confidence-in-Coverage program) are fully complete and generating $77K in recurring savings, while five additional categories representing $640K are in contract finalization or active implementation. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for RCM, distributor consolidation for medical supplies, and an in-house sonography staffing model.
